insert-payment-event.sql: INSERT INTO payments(event_id, intent_id, amount_cents, currency) SELECT json_extract(?1, '$.id'), json_extract(?1, '$.data.object.id'), json_extract(?1, '$.data.object.amount'), json_extract(?1, '$.data.object.currency') WHERE json_extract(?1, '$.type') = 'payment_intent.succeeded' ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING
